## Goal

Live demo matches the judging order. Slides do not count.

## Owns

`README.md` `TEAM.md` merges to `main` this laptop

## Done when

- [ ] Collaborators invited
- [ ] Browser on :8770, inspect, AGENTS.md ready
- [ ] Script: track sentence, J-01 pass, T-14 refuse, point at artifacts, stop
- [ ] Backup `python desk.py --demo`
- [ ] Freeze 15 minutes before demo. No more merges
